contract.title: D1 dynamic link rate round-6 cold-start review (commit 3acb6ce)
contract.goal: Review exact commit 3acb6cea21247fd6af28f0c17af84eae53aea2c6 on branch codex/20260819-d1-dynamic-rate. Round-5 (commit 5d9ad9b) REQUEST_CHANGES findings, both claimed fixed, to re-verify with fresh adversarial reading: (F4-DECIDE, both lanes) _decide() must attribute mcs_zero_rate_holds ONLY when geometry AND GE are up — the GSL deliver branch and the ISL candidate loop must not count a zero MCS rate when the corresponding GSL/ISL GE is down (receipt effective.mcs recomputes from this counter); verify the GE checks in _decide deliver + ISL candidate, and the new GE-down decision regression. (independent finding 2) the downlink MCS precise wait must include EVERY queued packet's deadline, not just q[0], so a tail packet with an earlier deadline creates a certified wake and expires at the exact deadline instead of degrading to time_step polling; verify the downlink heads list and the new tail-deadline regression (expires at 0.5 not 0.7). Also re-confirm round-4/5 items remain: F2-RACE unconditional deadline sweep after yield, F3 stop_time >= deadline inclusive, F4 _gsl_wait_until/_transmit geometry+GE attribution, F5 constant-rate GSL pre-gate, F1-R immediate hard-retirement cleanup. Confirm no regression in legacy RF/MCS equivalence, receipt counters, and overall test adequacy. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, concrete reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
